messages:
sara_support: FYI tagging CS — CedarBank (Enterprise trial) just hit repeated SSO token fail during initial ingest. Customer onboards tomorrow and finance flagged them as a renewal-risk if they don’t see momentum. Need urgent handoff and comms plan. Error: `401 invalid assertion` from IdP.

mike_cs_manager: @sara_support thanks for the heads-up. Can you paste the last support transcript + steps you tried? I’ll line up an enablement session and AE cover.

sara_support: pasted logs below and actions tried: 1) rotated SP metadata, 2) asked customer to re-sync clock, 3) temporary API token worked but they need SSO for compliance. transcript snippet: `2026-03-21T14:02 support: ssoAssertion invalid at verification step`

anya_se: @mike_cs_manager I can join a deep-dive. Do we have their SAML metadata? If the API token is working we can use that as a stopgap while we triage.

tom_ae: CedarBank is on a pilot contract w/ expected expansion if onboarding completes this quarter. Sales is watching — if we miss their kickoff tomorrow it likely delays purchase decision. I’ll be on the enablement call to escalate commercially.

eng_oncall: tagging from eng oncall — saw similar `invalid assertion` when IdP config had wrong audience URI. @sara_support can you confirm the SP entityID they sent?

sara_support: entityID from their IdP: `https://cedarbank-idp.example/saml`. Audience in our logs: `https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs`. mismatch looked likely. I asked them to confirm but no reply yet.

mike_cs_manager: Plan proposal: (A) Schedule a 30-min triage call right now with CedarBank + SE + AE + Support. (B) Use API-token onboarding flow as documented as temporary bypass — capture acceptance in writing. (C) CS to draft comms to customer and internal status note. Who owns the comms doc?

anya_se: I’ll draft the comms to CedarBank and include the workaround steps + ETA for SSO fix. Will link to the internal status doc.

tom_ae: I’ll send the commercial note to their procurement lead confirming workaround and expected fix timeline. Also offering extended pilot window if they need it.

eng_oncall: If audience URI mismatch, we can accept their audience as alternate for a short window. Need an eng approval and a config change on our SSO edge. I can do the change if CS asks — requires a quick config deploy (1-2m) and a rollback plan.

mike_cs_manager: OK — @eng_oncall please stand by to make the config change once CedarBank confirms the intended audience URI. @sara_support can you nudge them for the confirmation and propose a 13:30 PST triage call?

sara_support: pinged them via email and phone at 14:05. They replied at 14:08 confirming the audience should be `https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs` but their metadata was truncated in the initial upload. Available for 13:30 PST (they meant 13:30 local; converted to 20:30 UTC).

mike_cs_manager: Great — I’ll set a 20:30 UTC triage. Everyone please add this to your calendars. Action owners: Support (sara_support) — be primary convo owner and paste final logs into thread; SE (anya_se) — draft customer comms and shared doc; AE (tom_ae) — escalation to procurement + commercial cover; Eng (eng_oncall) — ready to accept temporary audience + deploy.

anya_se: Draft comms ready, sharing link in thread once internal doc created. Will include: what happened, temporary workaround steps (API token), expected timeline for SSO fix, and contact points.

tom_ae: I’ll prepare a short contract addendum offer in case they need pilot extension.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued by eng_oncall: change-saml-audience-allowlist v1 -> starting in 3m. CI checks passed.

eng_oncall: Deployment completed at 20:24 UTC. Verified acceptance of alternate audience for cedarbank-idp. Please test SSO flow on the call.

sara_support: On triage call now — SSO login succeeded after deploy. Customer confirmed they will re-upload full metadata. They accepted using API token for ingest in the meantime.

mike_cs_manager: Excellent. Follow-ups: 1) anya_se to send comms to customer + confirm documented workaround (EOD). 2) eng_oncall to schedule automated rollback if no traffic in 72h. 3) tom_ae confirm commercial note to procurement. 4) sara_support close support ticket with link to comms and next-step checklist.

anya_se: Comms sent at 21:15 UTC to CedarBank and internal doc shared: https://docs.internal/redwood/cedarbank-onboard-fix (customer copy redacted).

tom_ae: Procurement updated at 21:30 UTC — they appreciated the quick triage. Will follow up Monday for formal sign-off.

mike_cs_manager: Thanks team — marking as high-priority handoff complete. I’ll convert this into a CS play summary and add to renewal watchlist. :thumbsup:

sara_support: Closing thread — will reopen if any regression.
